title: Uniqueness of vertex operator algebras arising from GKO-construction
summary: A series of vertex operator algebras are constructed by GKO-construction, which is a generalization of 3A-algebra and 6A-algebra. It is proved their vertex operator algebra structures are unique under nonzero assumptions on some elements of braiding matrices. Furthermore, we show each of them is generated by weight two subspace, i.e. the Griess algebra.
